Team —

Looping in our proposed stance so Jordan has a clear, negotiation-ready position:

- Defense control: offer a hybrid compromise. Redwood will accept defense control for third-party IP claims up to $250k of legal fees/costs; above that threshold, parties will have the right to appoint counsel subject to cooperation terms. This keeps litigation routing predictable while protecting Redwood from open-ended control obligations.

- Evidence collection & staging: Redwood accepts responsibility to collect and preserve the evidence listed in David's note (logs, prompt bundles, input/output snapshots, S3 pointers). We will store material in a secure, access-controlled bucket and provide a certified index to Nova upon request.

- Insurance offset: propose explicit offset language — Redwood's indemnity is reduced by any recoveries from Redwood's insurers, but not reduced by Nova's insurance. We also want mutual cooperation language for subrogation.

I prepared a short paragraph to insert into the MSA; Jordan, please send this back to Nova with the updated redline PDF. If Nova pushes back on the $250k threshold, we can move to a sliding ladder tied to order value (draft language attached in the PDF).

-Kimberly
